The function was tested with **10 test cases** covering all edge cases:

| Test Case | Input → Output | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Empty string | `""` → `""` | Edge: zero-length |
| Single character | `"a"` → `"a"` | Edge: length 1 |
| ASCII string | `"hello"` → `"olleh"` | Simple case |
| Palindrome | `"racecar"` → `"racecar"` | Same forwards/backwards |
| Unicode (Japanese) | `"こんにちは"` → `"はちにんこ"` | Multi-byte chars |
| Emoji | `"a😀b"` → `"b😀a"` | Emoji is 4 bytes |
| Accented chars | `"résumé"` → `"émusér"` | Combining chars |
| Mixed whitespace | `"a b c"` → `"c b a"` | Preserves spaces |
| Numbers & symbols | `"123!@#"` → `"#@!321"` | Non-alpha chars |
| With newline | `"ab\nc"` → `"c\nba"` | Control characters |
